biography: Patrick Sherrington didn't grow up around racing royalty. His father was a lorry driver, his mother a nurse. The roar of engines was a world away until his tenth birthday when his dad took him to a local karting track. The moment Patrick strapped into that tiny kart, a fire ignited. He wasn't just driving; he was wrestling the machine, pushing it beyond its limits, a raw aggression bubbling to the surface. Early karting successes were fueled more by sheer tenacity than refined skill. He crashed… a lot. But he also won… a lot. One defining moment came at the regional karting championships. Down to the last lap, Patrick executed a daring overtake, clipping wheels with his rival. The move earned him the win but also a stern talking-to from the stewards. This blend of talent and recklessness caught the eye of MCR S2000 scouts. Now, at 21, Patrick is navigating the fiercely competitive world of S2000 racing, a rising star with a reputation for bold maneuvers and a no-holds-barred approach. He's learning to temper his aggression, but the underlying fire remains, ready to be unleashed.
drivingStyle: Patrick's driving style is characterized by aggressive corner entries and late braking. He prefers to hustle the car, often flirting with the limit of adhesion. Tire management is an area he's actively working on, as his early races often saw him pushing too hard, too soon. Under pressure, Patrick tends to become even more assertive, sometimes leading to mistakes, but also spectacular overtakes. He's a driver who thrives on the thrill of the chase and isn't afraid to take risks.

rivalries.reason: Rossi, a seasoned S2000 veteran, publicly criticized Patrick's aggressive driving after a near-miss incident on track. Patrick considers her a 'stuffy' driver lacking the killer instinct.

Thorne and Sherrington were karting rivals. Thorne, known for his calculated approach, always seemed to edge out Patrick. Their rivalry has reignited in S2000, with Patrick determined to finally surpass Thorne.

Nakamura and Sherrington are both young and hungry drivers. They have different styles, but they have been known to push each other to the limit during races. They are often seen battling for position on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of blue socks, no matter how tattered.
Listens to heavy metal at ear-splitting volume right before getting into the car.
Visually traces the track layout on the steering wheel before every race start.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe. It's about pushing boundaries, finding the edge, and going over it if you have to."
careerHighlight: Winning the Silverstone S2000 race in his rookie season after starting from P15. He carved his way through the field with a series of audacious overtakes, proving his raw talent and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Brands Hatch race due to over-exuberance. The incident cost him valuable championship points and drew heavy criticism from his team.
